newsitem.title: USA: RESEARCH ALERT - Advanced Fibre raised.
newsitem.headline: RESEARCH ALERT - Advanced Fibre raised.

text.p: -- Hambrecht & Quist said its analyst Joe Noel has raised estimates on Advanced Fibre Communications Inc. Noel lifted his 1997 earnings estimate to $0.74/shr from $0.68 and his 1997 revenue forecast to $234.7 million from $203.1 million.
-- In a statement, Noel said the company's March orders appear to remain strong, and he believes that "upside to (the) estimates is likely."
-- Noel said robust international sales seem to be counterbalancing seasonally lower domestic sales.
-- Shares of Advanced Fibre were up 1-1/4 at 43-1/4.
